classificationDefinitions.EXISTING_VERIFIED: Verified by repository code/migration inspection at the approved HEAD; runtime qualification remains a later gate.
classificationDefinitions.PARTIALLY_EXISTING: Some required contract exists but does not close the offline requirement.
classificationDefinitions.MISSING: No complete contract was identified in the approved repository inspection.
